title: Rav Shmuel bar Achitai

paragraphs: In [Gittin 39b](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.39b.17): Rav Shmuel bar Achitai reports Rav Hamnuna the Elder, who reports Rabbi Yitzchak bar Ashyan, who reports Rav Huna, etc.

And in [Sukkah 42a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sukkah.42a.6) the reading is Rav Shmuel bar Chatai, but Hyman reports Achitai from a manuscript cited in Dikdukei Soferim and from a manuscript of Keritot 12b.[^3][^2]

notes.text: The complete Gittin 39b paragraph explicitly names Rav Huna after Yitzchak bar Ashyan. Hyman’s quotation ends before the following Hamnuna report, and that ending remains etc. The manuscript readings Achitai and Chatai are retained.

The consulted Gittin continues the chain with Rav Huna reporting Rav Hamnuna, where Hyman ends with “etc.” The Sukkah chain instead ends with Rav Huna reporting Rav. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3367&lang=en) records the extra Hamnuna in Gittin and treats it as a scribal error.

The parallel in [Sheiltot d'Rav Achai Gaon 81:1](https://www.sefaria.org/Sheiltot_d%27Rav_Achai_Gaon.81.1) gives Shmuel bar Achitai without the title Rav. It continues through Rav Hamnuna the Elder, Rabbi Yitzchak bar Ashyan and Rav Huna to Rav. The consulted [Keritot 13b:13](https://www.sefaria.org/Keritot.13b.13) instead gives Rav Yehudah bar Achotai in the parallel ruling. Hyman’s manuscript reading for Keritot 12b remains as he reports it.
